description.value:
An Iconic Cyberdeck: 8 Program slots and 2 Hardware slots, and it only works installed in a Cybersuite. Once in, it stays in for a month, unless you pay 5,000eb and spend a week in a Hospital having it taken out. While you run it you get +1 NET Action every Turn, and you can take more than your limit: each NET Action past it costs 2 Humanity. It gives you the Blackwall Gateway quickhack. Now and then, while you use it, you hear voices from the far side of the Blackwall. Play that. Blackwall Gateway (DV 10, +2 per extra target, max 14): choose up to 2 more targets within 20 m/yds of the first. One roll covers all three; the second is hit the Round after the first, the third the Round after that. It works however many Passwalls you've Breached. Every attempt, hit or miss, costs you 1d6 Humanity and 1d6 HP. A target it hits takes 6d6 straight to HP (no ablation) and 1d6 Humanity Loss, loses 1d6 MOVE for 3 Rounds, and suffers Short Circuit; a double 6 also gives them Brain Injury (no Bonus Damage). Seriously Wounded: 8d6, −2d6 MOVE and Prone. Mortally Wounded: also an immediate Death Save at +10 Death Save Penalty.

Cost: Super Luxury • DV29 - 30,000eb - 6 Months

Item Compendium (2070) • Iconics
